'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Reid Smith LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet '''R Smith'''; username '''3MW048'''; dest [[Reid Smith]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Username:''' 3MW048
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
